verdict.rationale: Attio documents kanban and table views (attio-docs-34) and a standard Deal object (attio-docs-13, attio-docs-30), and its lists model business processes (attio-docs-29), so a visual deal pipeline is plausible. Reporting shows stage conversion metrics (attio-docs-112), which implies stages exist, and fields are customizable (attio-docs-46). However, the Deal object is disabled by default and needs an admin to enable it, and nothing explicitly confirms the other parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of customizable pipeline stages, drag-and-drop stage updates on the kanban, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
